Hi Fediverse 👋 #introduction

I'm Mohanad, a web & database developer from Gaza. Before the war I ran a small software office: Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Oracle.

Today my office is a tent in central Gaza, displaced from Beit Hanoun. I code on a borrowed laptop whenever I find electricity, and volunteer building systems for displaced families.

I lost my home and my office. Not the developer in me.

Glad to meet fellow devs here.

#Introductions #Gaza #Palestine #PHP #Laravel #WebDev #Programming
